analysis.finding: For one identical ZIP, the two Astra Pro fresh-start reports were already byte/inode exhausted before extraction; two GPT-5.6 Sol Pro fresh-start reports had substantial free capacity. Initial exhaustion is therefore present before this packet extraction in these reports.
analysis.interpretation: Starting environment setup or retained state is better supported than this packet extraction as the initial cause. Later extraction/work can consume additional capacity. The reports do not establish a model-specific quota, independent sessions, the storage owner, or how to reset platform state.
limits: Model and freshness labels are supplied by reviewers, not authenticated by the owner.
Root filesystem measured once per report; /tmp and /workspace aliases are not added as separate storage.
Reports from different chats are compared descriptively, not treated as a single shared mount or paired same-process delta.
free_bytes and available_bytes differ; use available_bytes for capacity available to the process.
No directory-content scan, deletion, quota change or new reviewer duty.
